colors.help: Preview gradient colors for your terminal
colors.name: colors

config.help: Show config file and current settings
config.name: config

args.help: Claude Code profile directory to operate on; defaults to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when that is set, and to ~/.claude otherwise. A leading ~ is expanded to your home directory
args.name: dir

install.help: Add howmuchleft as the statusLine in a Claude Code profile's settings.json, writing a command entry that points back at that profile directory, then register the profile so it shows up in the dashboard. Reports and overwrites a statusLine another tool configured, and changes nothing when howmuchleft is already installed there
install.name: install

flags.help: Redraw the dashboard every 30 seconds until interrupted, instead of printing a single snapshot and exiting immediately
flags.name: live

list.help: Discover every registered Claude Code profile and render their token usage side by side in one dashboard, a row per profile. Prints a single snapshot and exits by default; with --live it redraws every 30 seconds until interrupted. Reports that none were found, and exits cleanly, when no profile has been registered yet
list.name: list

args.help: Claude Code profile directory to operate on; defaults to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when that is set, and to ~/.claude otherwise. A leading ~ is expanded to your home directory
args.name: dir

uninstall.help: Remove howmuchleft's statusLine entry from a Claude Code profile's settings.json and unregister the profile so it no longer appears in the dashboard. Refuses to touch a statusLine that some other tool configured, printing it for inspection instead, and reports plainly when the profile has no statusLine at all
uninstall.name: uninstall

profile.help: Install, remove and inspect the Claude Code profiles howmuchleft tracks: wire the statusLine into a profile's settings.json, take it back out again, and show every registered profile's token usage side by side in one dashboard
profile.name: profile
